fact_en: Pure gold is actually a very soft metal! You can easily bend and shape it into anything.
fact_bis: Ang puro nga bulawan usa ka humok kaayo nga metal! Sayon nimong baliko-on ug hulmahon sa bisan unsang porma.
evidence: The title 'Lumot Bulawan Puro' reads as 'moss gold pure' — lumot is moss/algae in every one of the corpus's 102 Cebuano uses — while the card is about pure gold being humok (soft).

fact_en: Oil is also used to make plastics, detergents, medicines, paints, and synthetic cloth—things we use every day!
fact_bis: Gikan sa lana mahimo usab ang plastik, sabon, tambal, pintura, ug sintetikong panapton—mga butang nga gigamit nato adlaw-adlaw!
evidence: In the corpus 'gamot' means plant root in 450 bodies against 3 for medicine (medicine is 'tambal', as this card's own body says), so the headline lists 'root' among the things made from oil.

fact_en: Melted glass is soft like honey! It gets blown or pressed into a mold while hot, then cools and hardens into a perfect bottle or glass shape.
fact_bis: Ang natunaw nga salamin humok sama sa dugos! Gihuyop o gihulma kini samtang init, dayon mabugnaw ug magahi sa perpektong porma sa botelya o baso.
evidence: 'Natunaw Lumot Hulma Bote' displays as 'melted moss moulded into a bottle'; the card is about melted glass being humok (soft like honey), and lumot never means soft anywhere in the corpus.

fact_en: In medicine factories, chromatography checks if a drug is pure and safe! If an extra substance shows up, scientists know something is wrong with the medicine.
fact_bis: Sa pabrika sa tambal, gisusi sa chromatography kung putli ug luwas ang tambal! Kung naay mogawas nga dugang nga sangkap, nahibaw-an sa mga siyentista nga naay sayop.
evidence: 'Gamot Susihon sa Chromatography' reads to a Cebuano child as 'roots are checked by chromatography' (gamot = root in 450 of 473 corpus bodies) while the card's own body says tambal, i.e. drugs in a medicine factory.

fact_en: Gold is a solid metal, not a liquid! It is softer than other metals, making it easy to gently bend and shape into beautiful jewelry without breaking.
fact_bis: Solid nga metal ang bulawan, dili likido! Mas humok kini kaysa ubang metal, mao nga sayon kini nga hinay-hinayng baliko-on ug hulmahon nga nindot nga alahas nga dili mabuak.
evidence: 'Bulawan Solido Lumot' says gold is a solid MOSS; the card's point is that gold is humok (softer than other metals), and lumot is moss/algae in 102/102 corpus bodies.

fact_en: Tissue is a soft paper with loose fibers that soaks up water easily! It is perfect for wiping, even though it is still made from wood.
fact_bis: Ang tisyu usa ka humok nga papel nga may luag nga hibla aron dali makasuyop og tubig! Maayo kini ipahid bisan hinimo gihapon kini sa kahoy.
evidence: 'Tisyu Lumot Fiber Tubig' reads as tissue made of moss fibres — actively misleading for a card that says tissue is humok paper made from wood, and lumot never carries a 'soft' sense in the corpus.

fact_en: Igneous rocks form when molten rock cools! Magma cooling slowly underground makes large crystals like granite. Lava cooling quickly at the surface makes small crystals like basalt.
fact_bis: Mo-porma ang igneous rocks kung mobugnaw ang tinunaw nga bato! Ang mabagal nga magma sa ilalom naghimo og dagkong kristal (granite). Ang paspas nga lava sa ibabaw naghimo og gagmayng kristal (basalt).
evidence: Last word "Igneo" is cut off; the card itself contains "Igneous".

fact_en: The milligram is used to weigh very tiny amounts, like the dose in medicine!
fact_bis: Ang miligramo gigamit aron sukoron ang gagmay kaayo nga gibug-aton, sama sa dose sa tambal!
evidence: 'Miligramo Gamot Dose' headlines a root dose — gamot is plant root in 450 of 473 Cebuano bodies and this card's own body uses tambal for medicine.

fact_en:
What is the softest mineral in the world, and what is its hardness score?

Talc is the softest mineral! It has a hardness of just 1 on the Mohs scale.
fact_bis:
Unsa ang pinakahumok nga mineral sa kalibutan, ug unsa ang katigasan niini?

Ang talc (talko) mao ang pinakahumok nga mineral! Adunay katigasan kini nga 1 ra sa Mohs scale.
evidence: 'Talc Lumot Mohs 1' displays as 'talc moss Mohs 1' on a card whose whole point is that talc is the pinakahumok (softest) mineral; lumot means moss/algae in 102/102 corpus bodies.

fact_en: During the rock cycle, igneous rocks form when molten magma cools down! It undergoes a physical change to become a solid crystalline structure.
fact_bis: Sa rock cycle, ang igneous rocks mabuo kung mobugnaw ang molten magma! Mo-undergo kini og physical change aron mahimong solid crystalline structure.
evidence: Last word "Igneo" is cut off; the card itself contains "Igneous".

fact_en:
How does molten magma become hard rock?

When it reaches the Earth's surface or crust, it cools and solidifies into hard igneous rock!
fact_bis:
Unsaon pagiging hard rock sa molten magma?

Kung maabot ang surface o crust sa Earth, mo-cool down kini ug mo-solidify ngadto sa hard igneous rock!
evidence: Last word "Igneo" is cut off; the card itself contains "Igneous".

fact_en: The Philippine tarsier's dense fur traps a layer of gas close to its skin! This clever trick prevents rapid heat loss.
fact_bis: Ang daghang balhibo sa Philippine tarsier nag-trap og layer of gas duol sa panit! Malikayan niini ang dali nga pagkawala sa kainit.
evidence: Last word "Tarsie" is cut off; the card itself contains "Tarsier".
